name: Defending
overview: Scripture teaches that defending is a vital responsibility that encompasses protecting God’s honor, standing firm in our faith, and safeguarding others, including our families and ourselves. The Psalms remind us that the Lord equips us with strength and skill to fight (Psalms 144:1), while Proverbs calls believers to speak up for those who cannot defend themselves and to rescue those facing destruction (Proverbs 24:11; 31:8). Defending righteousness means not yielding to wickedness, as a righteous person who submits to the wicked is compared to a corrupted spring (Proverbs 25:26). At the same time, the law acknowledges the right to self-defense in certain circumstances (Exodus 22:2), even as Jesus teaches restraint from retaliation beyond what is just (Matthew 5:38).
